explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: The label for our acyclovir sodium product names Aurobindo Pharma Limited as the manufacturing plant, which was classified OAI on 2026-02-06.
The same facility, operating as Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited, received a Warning Letter on 2024-08-15 and another OAI classification on 2024-02-02.
A recall by AuroMedics Pharma LLC for particulate matter in acyclovir sodium injection was initiated on 2022-09-26 and completed.
Corvale East has 39 days of supply on hand, Corvale General has 17 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 25 days.
The best option by rule is to buy from Eugia US LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

Q-69fca0.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%acyclovir%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%acyclovir%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-11c94f.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('d3ab226c-677d-4cb7-85cb-1c2e5012f40d', 'c40a57b9-4cf1-4a69-abf3-eb99a7fcda00', 'f98aea50-e4d9-c0cc-e053-6294a90a811c') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-208bfe.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%acyclovir%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-31c3b9.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%acyclovir%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-73ec2a.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%acyclovir%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-e09742.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3008461619', '1831143') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-ebfeba.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1450743', '3008461619', '1831143') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('a s medication solutions', 'aurobindo', 'eugia specialities', 'northwind health')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-724dfa.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('a s medication solutions', 'aurobindo', 'eugia specialities', 'northwind health', 'auromedics') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%acyclovir%' ORDER BY initiation_date
